description: This file is a code-behind for the Dashboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It contains event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different pages such as User Profile, Leaderboard, Start Exam, and Login.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Dashboard.aspx page, handles events related to user navigation within the dashboard.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently does nothing on page load.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the homepage button, currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the User Profile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Leaderboard page when the corresponding button is clicked.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Starts the exam by navigating to the Start Exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by navigating to the Login page.
